Aluminum doors in Riyadh

Order custom aluminum doors in Riyadh for entrances, interiors, balconies and gardens. We measure the opening and help select a hinged, sliding or folding system, along with the glass, lock and frame finish.

Fabrication options

Service options

Entrance doors

Hinged main doors with a sturdy frame and a choice of finishes.

Sliding doors

Patio and balcony doors that open without a swing clearance.

Folding doors

Security doors

Glazing and lock options for greater resistance to breakage and forced entry.

Materials and finish

Specifications and options

Should I choose a sliding or a hinged door?

Check the clearance around the opening. Sliding panels run along the frame, while a hinged door needs space to swing. Send the opening width, height and preferred direction. To match nearby glazing and frame finishes, compare our aluminum window options.

  • Corrosion-resistant aluminum.
  • Thermal and acoustic insulation options.
  • Choice of locks and security hardware.
  • Multiple colors and finishes.
  • Break-resistant glazing.
  • Five-year warranty on doors.
